title: Diamond Item Smelting
description: Smelt your diamond items in a blast furnace to reclaim diamonds.
body:
## Smelt your Diamond items in a Blast Furnace to reclaim diamonds! 

Vanilla lets us smelt gold, iron, chainmail, & copper tools & armor to reclaim gold, iron, & copper nuggets. Now you can smelt down your diamond items too!

This datapack allows smelting of diamond armors, tools, & weapons in the Blast Furnace!
_Note: can only be done in the Blast Furnace, not regular Furnaces or Smokers_

Fuel Consumption:
Default fuel consumption: 8 items per coal

Smelting tips:
- use auto-smelter setup to feed items in & out with hoppers
- use short fuel sources that aren't wasted after single items (example in photos: saplings)

**Great in 1.20+ Updates by repurposing your Diamond Gear and getting your diamonds for copying armor trim & upgrade templates! **﻿


Items that can be smelted:
- Diamond Axe
- Diamond Hoe
- Diamond Pickaxe
- Diamond Shovel
- Diamond Spear (in 1.21.11+)
- Diamond Sword
- Diamond Horse Armor
- Diamond Nautilus Armor (in 1.21.11+)
- Diamond Boots
- Diamond Chestplate
- Diamond Helmet
- Diamond Leggings
